services.name: Tahoe Cruises
services.desc: Tahoe Cruises has run sightseeing trips out of Ski Run Marina since 1979 and operates two yachts from the dock. The Safari Rose is a classic 80-foot motor yacht built in 1959, restored with a teak-paneled salon, a full bar, a fireplace, and sun decks, and it remains the only yacht on the lake with onboard staterooms; premium wine-tasting cruises, private charters, and weddings. The Spirit of Tahoe is the larger vessel, carrying up to 133 passengers with two bars and an upper deck, and handles most of the daily public cruises, including year-round runs. Trips range from roughly two-hour Emerald Bar sightseeing cruises - passing Vikingsholm, Eagle Falls, and the Tea House on Fannette Island,

services.name: Tahoe Sportfishing
services.desc: Family-owned since 1953, Tahoe Sportfishing operates the only year-round charter fishing fleet on Lake Tahoe. Their six Coast Guard-certified boats, ranging from 30 to 45 feet, depart daily from Ski Run Marina, offering both morning (five-hour) and afternoon (four-hour) trips. Anglers can target Mackinaw Lake Through year-round, along with Brown and Rainbow Trout, and Kokanee Salmon during the summer and fall seasons. Every charter includes rods, tackle, bait, fuel, an experienced captain and deckhand, coffee on early trips, and fish cleaning and bagging at the end of the day. Guests simply need a California or Nevada fishing license, which can be purchased at the office. Public charters
